primary_change: No visual evolution — BrandSpec fidelity only
rationale: Content strategy is preserve-and-modernize. BrandSpec already encodes the classical, restrained, typography-forward personality appropriate for Merimee's mission-driven, faith-aligned clientele. Introducing visual deltas would risk alienating existing brand advocates (Chesterton Academy, Holy Rollers) without compensating upside. The migration modernizes execution (CSS custom properties, fluid layout, prefers-reduced-motion, full dark mode) while preserving brand identity exactly. Stitch MCP unavailable in this run; decisions derived directly from BrandSpec tokens and motion philosophy.

motion_delta.rationale: BrandSpec motion_philosophy=classical. Duration 200ms ease-out for micro-interactions; 400ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) spring for modals. All motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

designer_notes: Single page discovered; VisualDirection scoped to '/' route only.
Hero should be typography-only with optional subtle gradient on --color-primary-container; defer hero photography until brand refinement phase.
Indigo accent (#6366F1) reserved for CTAs, focus rings, and active states — do not apply to large surface areas.
All focus indicators use 2px solid var(--brand-accent) with 2px offset; never outline:none without replacement.
Dark mode tokens defined in BrandSpec (full_tokens); default theme is light, data-theme='dark' toggles inversion.
Merriweather for all headings including h1-h6; Source Sans 3 for body, labels, captions.
Card hover uses motion-classical (scale 1.02 + shadow-md); button hover uses motion-subtle (opacity 0.9) — restraint matters for classical brand voice.
Container max-widths: 640 / 768 / 1024 / 1280 with padding escalating 16/16/24/32 px.
Spacing philosophy on home is 'spacious' — section vertical padding uses --space-3xl (64px) on desktop, --space-2xl (48px) on mobile.
